objective: Verify mutation campaign survives SIGTERM interrupt and resumes correctly.
decision: M45.6 QUALIFIED: Campaign interrupt/resume is reliable. Counts match after SIGTERM-induced interruption. Source tree is restored. No orphan processes detected. Cache is regenerated cleanly on the next run; mutmut's .meta is preserved when the interrupt occurs after population generation, but this test caught the run before population write which is the simpler correctness scenario.
